items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: But that's the first of me hearing of that.

ctx.x: Because Charile's supposed to have gone off to the Ozarks that next summer, I think with George Lee or one of the bands, and there was nothing to do but study there. So he really learned all of Lester Young's solos, and he got himself straightened out.
Yeah, it might have been. I went down there with George Lee and stayed one summer down in the Ozarks. It might have been. But that's the first of me hearing of that.
